prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1048; do not mention it.)
text: This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the rear-end collision described in your file. Our client was hurt in the incident and is currently receiving medical care for injuries that were directly caused by the impact. Please direct all future communication regarding this matter, including requests for statements, recorded interviews, and settlement discussions, exclusively to this office, and do not contact our client directly. We also ask that you provide written confirmation of the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to the at-fault driver, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Finally, we request that your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision, including photographs, vehicle data, repair estimates, telematics, claim notes, witness statements, and any recorded communications. Please acknowledge receipt of this letter promptly.
